prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1107; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache that began within hours of the incident. Initial examination showed reduced cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness, and mild restriction with extension and rotation. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits or reflex changes in the upper extremities. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture and showed no acute bony abnormality.

Over the course of 19 visits, treatment consisted of a combination of manual therapy, progressive cervical range-of-motion exercises, soft tissue work, and a home stretching program. Pain levels were tracked at each visit and showed a steady downward trend, with headache frequency decreasing first, followed by improvement in neck mobility and reduced muscle guarding. Sleep disruption and difficulty with prolonged computer use were the most persistent functional complaints during the middle phase of care.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-full cervical range of motion with minimal residual tenderness and reported that daily activities were largely back to baseline. Ongoing home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
